visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails sits in a blue stroller being pushed along a paved path in a lush green park. She wears a white top and tan shorts, holding onto the front bar with both hands. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) A slightly older girl in a blue shirt and denim shorts runs away from the camera down the path, surrounded by dense green bushes and trees. (3) The younger girl walks on a wooden plank deck, held by an adult's hand. She wears pink sandals and looks down at her steps. (4) An indoor/outdoor stage scene where a man in a traditional brown and black kimono performs, gesturing with his hands. The girl watches from the audience, her face showing intense focus. (5) The girl, sitting on an adult's lap, reaches out to throw a coin into a wooden box. Other people are visible in the background sitting on benches. (6) The girl stands outdoors next to a stone lantern, now dressed in a white yukata with red floral patterns and a red sash. She looks to the side with a curious expression. (7) Inside a shop, the girl wears a yellow patterned yukata and drinks from a juice box through a straw. (8) The girl runs on a gravel path near traditional Japanese wooden buildings. She stops and looks around, appearing surprised or curious. (9) A close-up of the girl's face as she looks up at something off-screen with wide eyes. (10) A parade scene where several women in elaborate geisha attire and high wooden sandals walk under a large red umbrella held by a man. A crowd of onlookers with phones is visible in the background. (11) A man in a traditional headband and outfit pours syrup onto a large bowl of shaved ice. The girl then holds the orange shaved ice and smiles for a photo. (12) At night, the girl is back in her stroller on a tiled sidewalk. An adult holds two skewers of fruit (strawberries and grapes) with marshmallows. (13) Close-up of the girl happily biting into a strawberry and marshmallow skewer. (14) Outro animation with a pink background and a cartoon girl holding a snack.
